адреса: the number, street and town where you live
ванна кімната: the room with a bath or shower
вікно: a glass opening in a wall
вітальня: the room where you sit and relax
двері: you open it to go into a room
диван: a long soft seat for two or more people; couch
душ: you stand under it to wash
квартира: an apartment; rooms on one floor of a building
ключ: you open a lock with it
кімната: a part of a house with walls and a door
підлога; поверх: the part you walk on; also a level of a building
сад, садок (біля будинку): land with grass and flowers near a house
стіл: a piece of furniture you eat or work at
туалет: a WC; a room for washing your hands and more
